name: AI Agents
author: cbrompton
description: Token history, pace detail, and Claude account switching in one bar panel. Merges Omarchy's agent usage collectors with ai-usagebar; both are optional.

barWidget.description: Rate-limit meters with pace, tokens by day and by model, and a switch for which Claude account the CLI is signed into.

schema.label: Show usage value
schema.description: Show the selected provider's percentage or balance next to its mark in the top bar.

schema.label: Show provider name
schema.description: Prefix the bar value with the provider's short code (cld, gpt, zai). Off by default.

schema.label: Show all providers
schema.description: Show every provider's mark and usage in the top bar at once, instead of one at a time.

schema.label: Top bar usage window
schema.description: Which quota window the top bar shows. Auto keeps the fullest; the others pin a window and fall back to the fullest where a provider lacks it.

schema.label: Claude account switching
schema.description: Show the account switch in the panel. It is disabled automatically while a Claude session is running.

schema.label: Synced aggregation
schema.description: When On, write this machine's local usage snapshot and merge snapshots from other machines.

schema.label: Sync folder
schema.description: A folder synced by Syncthing, Dropbox, rsync, etc.

schema.label: Device id
schema.description: Optional stable device name used inside synced aggregate snapshots.
